title: Alexa, Google, Siri: What are Your Pronouns? Gender and Anthropomorphism in the Design and Perception of Conversational Assistants

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing user pronoun usage in online reviews and forums via anaphora resolution to measure perception, calculating cosine similarity between system output word embeddings and male/female-associated word lists, and conducting stylometric analysis using LIWC to compare system outputs against gender-labelled film scripts.
